_doc: Manifest for the 1812 yard layer (T-3458): the yard goods round the 1812 houses. A static host cannot be globbed, so the renderer fetches this file and then exactly the records it names. data/scenes/1812.json names `yard_dir: yard/1812/`; the 1835 town reads data/yard/index.json.
coordinates: Local East-North-Up metres from data/datum.json's origin.
